fields.label: Sender
fields.description: Default sender details used on shipping labels. Leave blank to inherit per-Company / Address defaults.

fields.label: Tracking Monitoring
fields.description: Carrier-independent tracking behaviour: polling cutoff and the daily problem digest.

fields.label: Tracking Cutoff (Days)
fields.description: Shipments older than this are no longer polled at FedEx/GLS and drop out of the stuck-shipment check.

fields.label: Stuck Threshold (Days)
fields.description: A non-delivered shipment whose latest tracking event is older than this appears in the daily digest.

fields.label: Digest Recipients
fields.description: Email addresses, separated by comma, semicolon or newline.

fields.label: Pickup Reminder
fields.description: Customer e-mail for a parcel deposited at a post office / ParcelShop / Hold-at-Location that has not been collected. One mail per Shipment, sent by the daily 09:00 run.

fields.label: Remind After (Days)
fields.description: Mail the customer once the parcel has been ready for pickup for MORE than this many calendar days.

fields.label: Sender
fields.description: Optional. Leave empty for the default outgoing Email Account.

fields.label: Email Template (DE)
fields.description: Context: doc (Shipment), customer_name, orders, pickup (carrier, tracking_number, location, ready_since_formatted, days_waiting). Without a template a built-in text is used.

fields.label: Shipping Notification
fields.description: Customer e-mail once a Shipment has a tracking number. One mail per recipient and run (12:30 and 17:30), listing all parcels labelled since the last run.

fields.label: Notify Shipments Created From
fields.description: Set automatically when the notifications are switched on. Shipments created before this moment are never mailed.

fields.label: Sender
fields.description: Optional. Leave empty for the default outgoing Email Account.

fields.label: Tracking Page URL
fields.description: Link to the shop's tracking page, e.g. https://www.example.com/{language}/tracking/{token}. {token} is replaced by the order's secret token, {language} by de or en. Leave empty to send the mail without a link.

fields.label: Email Template (DE)
fields.description: Context: customer_name, company, orders, parcel_count, tracking_links (order, url), shipments (carrier, tracking_number, orders, items, address_lines, is_parcel_shop, tracking_url). Without a template a built-in text is used.

fields.label: Delivery Note Print Format
fields.description: Optional. Leave empty for the default Print Format of Delivery Note.

fields.label: Packing
fields.description: What the station offers to pack. Non-stock lines are charges (freight fee, import duty) and stay hidden -- except Items in these groups: a repair is a service on the order, but the repaired shoe is what goes in the box.

fields.label: Packable Non-Stock Item Groups
fields.description: Item Groups (with their sub-groups) whose non-stock Items count as goods: packing list, orders to pack, shipping notification.
